All spells | Absorb Elements: Acid.note: It goes on its user, whoever is targeted. Pick the triggering damage type's row. The Resistance counts against the triggering damage too: give back what it would have halved. The first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of that type (1d6 more per slot level above 1), and the spell ends.

All spells | Absorb Elements: Cold.note: It goes on its user, whoever is targeted. Pick the triggering damage type's row. The Resistance counts against the triggering damage too: give back what it would have halved. The first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of that type (1d6 more per slot level above 1), and the spell ends.

All spells | Absorb Elements: Fire.note: It goes on its user, whoever is targeted. Pick the triggering damage type's row. The Resistance counts against the triggering damage too: give back what it would have halved. The first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of that type (1d6 more per slot level above 1), and the spell ends.

All spells | Absorb Elements: Lightning.note: It goes on its user, whoever is targeted. Pick the triggering damage type's row. The Resistance counts against the triggering damage too: give back what it would have halved. The first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of that type (1d6 more per slot level above 1), and the spell ends.

All spells | Absorb Elements: Thunder.note: It goes on its user, whoever is targeted. Pick the triggering damage type's row. The Resistance counts against the triggering damage too: give back what it would have halved. The first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of that type (1d6 more per slot level above 1), and the spell ends.

All spells | Bless.note: Each target adds 1d4 to its attack rolls and saving throws for the duration.

All spells | Booming Blade.note: One melee attack with the weapon used in the casting, against a creature within 5 feet: give the weapon's own attack bonus and damage. Extra Thunder damage on a hit: 1d8 from character level 5, 2d8 from 11, 3d8 from 17.

All spells | Booming Blade: moved.note: If the target willingly moves 5 feet or more before the start of your next turn. Then the spell ends: take the badge off.

All spells | Burning Hands.note: Each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Flammable objects in it that aren't worn or carried start burning.
All spells | Burning Hands.summary: DC 15 DEX  3d6 Fire  half on save

All spells | Charm Person.note: Humanoids only. The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. It ends early if you or your allies damage the target.

All spells | Chill Touch.note: A melee spell attack. On a hit, the target can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

All spells | Chromatic Orb.note: If two or more of the d8s match, the orb leaps to another target within 30 feet: a new attack and damage roll. With a level 2+ slot it can leap as many times as the slot's level, each creature once. Its damage is of a type to choose (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Thunder): give one.

All spells | Command: Approach.note: On its next turn, the target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you.

All spells | Command: Drop.note: On its next turn, the target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

All spells | Command: Flee.note: On its next turn, the target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.

All spells | Command: Grovel.note: On its next turn, the target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn.

All spells | Command: Halt.note: On its next turn, the target doesn't move and takes no action or Bonus Action.

All spells | Cure Wounds.note: Add the spellcasting ability modifier to the healing.

All spells | Dissonant Whispers.note: On a failed save, the target must immediately use its Reaction, if available, to move as far away from you as it can by the safest route.
All spells | Dissonant Whispers.summary: DC 15 WIS  3d6 Psychic  half on save

All spells | Divine Favor.note: The caster's attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit: the badge goes on the caster.

All spells | Divine Smite.note: Cast right after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike: pick that target. On a critical hit, roll the dice twice. If the target is a Fiend or an Undead: 1d8 Radiant more. Add it for those targets.

All spells | Eldritch Blast.note: The beams can go at one target or several: lower Times and apply again for the others.

Enlarge/Reduce.text: Its attacks with its enlarged weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit.

All spells | Enlarge/Reduce: Enlarge.note: An unwilling target makes a Constitution save first; on a success, the spell has no effect.

Enlarge/Reduce.text: Its attacks with its reduced weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 less damage on a hit (not below 1).

All spells | Ensnaring Strike.note: Cast right after hitting with a weapon. A Large or larger creature has Advantage on the save. On a success the spell ends. While Restrained, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage (1d6 more per slot level above 1) at the start of each of its turns. It or a creature within reach can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to end the spell.

All spells | Entangle.note: Each creature other than you in the 20-foot square. The area is Difficult Terrain for the duration. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to free itself.

All spells | Faerie Fire.note: An affected creature sheds Dim Light, can't benefit from the Invisible condition, and attack rolls against it have Advantage if the attacker can see it.

All spells | False Life.note: It goes on its user, whoever is targeted.

All spells | Feather Fall.note: Up to five falling creatures descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from the fall when they land, which ends the spell for them.

All spells | Fireball.summary: DC 15 DEX  8d6 Fire  half on save

All spells | Friends.note: The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you've cast this on it in the past 24 hours. The spell ends early if the target takes damage or you make an attack roll, deal damage or force a saving throw.

All spells | Grease.note: The 10-foot square is Difficult Terrain for the duration. A creature that enters it or ends its turn there makes the save again or falls Prone.

All spells | Green-Flame Blade.note: One melee attack with the weapon used in the casting, against a creature within 5 feet: give the weapon's own attack bonus and damage. Extra Fire damage on a hit: 1d8 from character level 5, 2d8 from 11, 3d8 from 17.

All spells | Green-Flame Blade: leaping.note: After a hit: a different creature you can see within 5 feet of the target. Add the spellcasting ability modifier to the damage.

All spells | Guidance.note: A willing creature adds 1d4 to ability checks with the skill you choose.

All spells | Guiding Bolt.note: On a hit, the next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

Haste.text: An additional action on each of its turns: the Attack (one attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide or Utilize action only.

All spells | Haste.note: When the spell ends, pick Haste: lethargy for the target.

All spells | Haste: lethargy.note: As Haste ends on the target: its badge then gives a Speed of 0 instead. Part of the same casting: it spends no slot.

All spells | Healing Word.note: Add the spellcasting ability modifier to the healing.

All spells | Heroes' Feast.note: Up to twelve creatures that partook of the feast, an hour after it was conjured; each rolls its own 2d10.

All spells | Heroism: Temporary Hit Poin.note: Each target gains them at the start of each of its turns while it has Heroism; the simulator gives them then. Type in the spellcasting ability modifier: it's the whole temp hp.

All spells | Hunter's Mark.note: You deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll, and have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception or Survival) checks to find it. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, a Bonus Action moves the mark to a new creature.

All spells | Ice Knife: explosion.note: The target and each creature within 5 feet of it. Part of the same casting: it spends no slot.

All spells | Ice Knife: shard.note: Hit or miss, the shard then explodes: pick Ice Knife: explosion next.

All spells | Ice Storm.note: The ground in the Cylinder is Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.
All spells | Ice Storm.summary: DC 15 DEX  2d10 Bludgeoning + 4d6 Cold  half on save

All spells | Invisibility.note: It ends right after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage or casts a spell.

All spells | Lightning Bolt.summary: DC 15 DEX  8d6 Lightning  half on save

All spells | Mage Armor.note: Pick a creature who isn't wearing armor; it ends if the target dons armor.

All spells | Magic Missile.note: Each dart strikes a creature of your choice: lower Times and apply again to split them.

All spells | Moonbeam.note: A shape-shifted creature that fails reverts to its true form. A creature also saves when the Cylinder moves into its space, and when it enters or ends its turn there (once per turn). A Magic action moves the Cylinder up to 60 feet.
All spells | Moonbeam.summary: DC 15 CON  2d10 Radiant  half on save

All spells | Produce Flame.note: Casting it (a Bonus Action) makes the flame; hurling it is a Magic action, on this turn or a later one.

Protection from Evil and Good.when: the attacker is an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend or Undead

All spells | Protection from Evil and Go.note: One willing creature you touch. It can't be possessed by, or gain the Charmed or Frightened condition from, an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend or Undead; if one already has, it has Advantage on any new save against that effect.

All spells | Resistance.note: Choose a damage type: when the creature takes damage of that type, it reduces the total by 1d4, once per turn.

All spells | Sacred Flame.note: The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this save.

All spells | Scorching Ray.note: The rays can go at one target or several: lower Times and apply again for the others.

All spells | See Invisibility.note: It goes on its user, whoever is targeted. You see creatures and objects with the Invisible condition as if they were visible.

All spells | Shatter.note: A Construct has Disadvantage on the save.
All spells | Shatter.summary: DC 15 CON  3d8 Thunder  half on save

All spells | Shield.note: It goes on its user, whoever is targeted. The +5 counts against the triggering attack too: if it now misses, take that hit back. You take no damage from Magic Missile until the start of your next turn.

All spells | Silence.note: Each creature entirely inside the 20-foot-radius Sphere: take Deafened and the Silence badge (Immunity to Thunder damage) off when it leaves. Inside, objects have Immunity to Thunder damage too, and no spell with a Verbal component can be cast.

All spells | Sleep.note: At the end of its next turn the target repeats the save: on a failure it has the Unconscious condition for the duration. It wakes if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet takes an action to shake it. Creatures that don't sleep, or are immune to Exhaustion, succeed automatically.

All spells | Spare the Dying.note: A creature with 0 Hit Points that isn't dead becomes Stable. Range 15 feet, doubling at character levels 5, 11 and 17.

All spells | Spike Growth.note: The 20-foot-radius area is Difficult Terrain. A creature takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet it moves into or within it. A creature that can't see the area when it's cast needs a Search action and a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check against your spell save DC to spot the danger.

Spirit Guardians.when: it ends its turn in the Emanation

All spells | Spirit Guardians.note: The badge goes on the caster, or on the enemies it's aimed at: either way the turn column asks, as each enemy of the caster ends its turn, whether it's in the 15-foot Emanation, for the damage row. Any other creature's Speed is halved in it.

All spells | Spirit Guardians: damage.note: When the Emanation enters a creature's space, or a creature enters it or ends its turn there; once per turn for each creature. Necrotic instead if the caster is evil. Cast with a higher slot: 1d8 more per level above 3 (type it in; picking a slot here spends one).
All spells | Spirit Guardians: damage.summary: DC 15 WIS  3d8 Radiant  half on save

All spells | Spiritual Weapon.note: On later turns, a Bonus Action moves the force up to 20 feet and repeats the attack. Add the spellcasting ability modifier to the damage.

All spells | Starry Wisp.note: On a hit, until the end of your next turn the target sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

All spells | Suggestion.note: The target must be able to hear and understand you. It ends early if you or your allies damage it, or when the suggested activity is done.

All spells | Tasha's Hideous Laughter.note: It can't end the Prone condition on itself. It also repeats the save each time it takes damage, with Advantage.

All spells | Thunderwave.note: Each creature in a 15-foot Cube from you. On a failed save it's also pushed 10 feet away from you.
All spells | Thunderwave.summary: DC 15 CON  2d8 Thunder  half on save

All spells | Toll the Dead.note: For a target that has all its Hit Points: pick the hurt-target row for one that's missing any.

All spells | Toll the Dead (hurt target).note: For a target missing any of its Hit Points.

All spells | True Strike.note: One attack with the weapon used in the casting, using your spellcasting ability for its attack and damage rolls: give the weapon's damage. It can deal Radiant damage instead of its own type. Extra Radiant damage: 1d6 from character level 5, 2d6 from 11, 3d6 from 17.

All spells | Vicious Mockery.note: On a failed save, the target also has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

All spells | Witch Bolt.note: On each of your later turns, a Bonus Action deals 1d12 Lightning damage to the target automatically, even if the first attack missed. It ends if the target is out of range or has Total Cover from you.
